SELECT 
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) / 3 AS avg_sat_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Moderate'
    END AS free_meal_category,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
    AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
    AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
GROUP BY 
    free_meal_category;

    "School Name",
    CASE
        WHEN "Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 'Pre-kindergarten'
        WHEN "High Grade" <= 8 THEN 'Elementary/Middle School'
        WHEN "High Grade" >= 9 THEN 'High School'
    END AS "Educational Level"

    JOIN (

SELECT 
    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS Spending ON t.CustomerID = Spending.CustomerID

    Spending.TotalSpending = (
        SELECT MAX(TotalSpending)
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
        ) AS MaxSpending
    )
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

WITH CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
MaxSpending AS (
    SELECT MAX(TotalSpending) AS MaxSpending
    FROM CustomerSpending
)
SELECT 
    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN 
    CustomerSpending cs ON t.CustomerID = cs.CustomerID
JOIN 
    MaxSpending ms ON cs.TotalSpending = ms.MaxSpending
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM ConvertedTimes;

    FROM member m

WITH bond_details AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        b.bond_type,
        a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        CASE 
            WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_5')
),
molecule_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        molecule m
    JOIN 
        atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        m.molecule_id = (SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_2')
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    bd.bond_id,
    bd.bond_type,
    bd.atom1_id,
    bd.atom1_element,
    bd.atom2_id,
    bd.atom2_element,
    bd.bond_classification,
    mc.atom_count,
    mc.bond_count
FROM 
    bond_details bd
JOIN 
    molecule_counts mc ON bd.bond_id LIKE mc.molecule_id || '%';
